text:
amelia.support: Customer ACME (org: acme-prod) opened an escalation, seeing widespread 504s during a morning burst. Ticket T-4281. They reported ~08:12-08:20 UTC spike. Can we triage?
kevin-oncall: Can you paste an example span/trace and the gateway logs for one of the 504s? link to ticket?
amelia.support: Pasting gateway line: `upstream timeout after 30s` and trace id r=abc123. Load repro: small spike 50->80 rps for 2m and 90% requests 504 after ~90s. Logs attached to ticket.
sanjay-eng: Quick glance at infra metrics: queue depth jumped, but HPA didn't create new pods for ~2m. KEDA ScaledObject in that namespace has pollingInterval: 60s and cooldownPeriod: 1800s — that cooldown is extremely long.
darren-sre: Also seeing readiness probe values on the model pods: `initialDelaySeconds: 60`, `failureThreshold: 5` -> this makes pod considered unready until ~300s if model init slow. Model cold-init is ~120-180s in our measurements. Combined it's bad.
kevin-oncall: Run `kubectl get hpa -n hosted-inference demo-model -o yaml` shows `minReplicas: 0` and no recent HPA events. If min=0 and KEDA pauses, the first pod is expensive to get ready.
amelia.support: Customer also reported an auth/billing 403 earlier at 07:55; billing-bot shows token rotation at that time, not sure related.
sanjay-eng: Hypothesis: KEDA metrics polling + long cooldown prevented timely scale triggers, HPA allowed minReplicas=0 so nothing to absorb burst, and the heavy readiness/init cost means pods only become Ready long after the queue grows -> gateway times out.
darren-sre: Short-term mitigations: set ScaledObject.cooldownPeriod -> 30s and pollingInterval -> 5s for the affected tier; set minReplicaCount: 1 for standard tenant pools; reduce readinessProbe initialDelay to 10s and add an init container to prefetch model weights.
kevin-oncall: Can we repro in staging? Steps I used: `./ops/loadtest/spike-50.sh --duration 120 --target demo-model.playpen.internal` — I can run now.
amelia.support: Running loadtest against staging now, will paste results.
pagerduty-bot: Incident priority escalated to P1 by amelia.support
amelia.support: Loadtest results: queue starts to back up at ~30s, first new pod created at ~92s, pod transitions Ready at ~235s, gateway 504s for whole period.
sanjay-eng: Repro confirmed. Root cause: combination of long ScaledObject cooldown (1800s) + pollingInterval (60s), HPA minReplicas=0, and model cold-init ~160s + readiness config -> effective scale-up latency >200s.
darren-sre: Plan of record (short-term): 1) Patch keda ScaledObject values for prod standard pool (pollingInterval=5s, cooldownPeriod=30s, minReplicaCount=1). 2) Reduce readiness initialDelay / add pre-warm init container. 3) Create warm pool (reserved idle pods) for high-traffic customers. I'll open PR to infra helm values and apply as canary to acme-prod.
kevin-oncall: I'll run the staging patch and then flip prod canary after green. Also add a temporary gateway fallback header to surface degraded 503s instead of 504s to customer.
amelia.support: Applied staging changes, re-ran loadtest: spike handled, new pods scale within ~20s and no 504s. Customer on acme-prod reports initial improvement after we enabled warm pool.
billing-bot: Note: billing system had retries at 07:55 due to token rotation, no sustained billing failures surfaced.
sanjay-eng: Follow-ups: add alert if `avg(pod_startup_seconds) > 90s` while `queue_depth > 50` for >2m. Also we should audit ScaledObject defaults — 1800s is too aggressive for bursty workloads.
darren-sre: Action items assigned: darren-sre -> PR for helm values + apply canary; sanjay-eng -> runtime heuristics/alerts and playbook update; kevin-oncall -> run rollout and monitor; amelia.support -> update customer ticket and playbook notes.
amelia.support: Thanks all. I'll keep T-4281 updated and mark P1 resolved after 30m of stability. :thumbsup:
kevin-oncall: FYI will add a short doc block in runbook: `If 504s with queue spike: check ScaledObject.cooldown/pollingInterval -> ensure minReplicaCount>=1 for latency-sensitive tiers`
sanjay-eng: Example ScaledObject snippet we used to repro/fix:
```yaml
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: demo-model-scaledobject
  namespace: hosted-inference
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    name: demo-model-deployment
  pollingInterval: 5  # seconds
  cooldownPeriod: 30
  minReplicaCount: 1
  triggers:
    - type: prometheus
      metadata:
        serverAddress: http://prometheus.monitoring.svc:9090
        metricName: queue_length
        threshold: '20'
```
sanjay-eng: We'll also add a test to the regression suite to simulate 50->150 rps spike and assert scale-up < 60s.
amelia.support: Customer confirms improved behavior. Closing P1 after 30m stable. Will paste incident writeup into /incident-postmortems/T-4281 later. Thanks everyone.
